column1: # Rasteriser charts, article pages 3–8, at 2.560 × 1.440 and 3.840 × 2.160.
# Imported 2026-10-17 for the site's "top played games" push: it is the only
# machine-readable multi-GPU source for Call of Duty: Black Ops 7, ARC Raiders and
# Battlefield 6, and the first to chart the RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB, RX 9060 XT 16 GB
# and RX 9070 GRE. The whole rasteriser parcours is taken, as with the RX 9070
# Figures read from each bar's data-value attribute by
# src/lib/perfEngine/computerbase.js — transcribed, never estimated off an image.
# Spot-checked by hand against the raw HTML: ARC Raiders 1440p, RTX 4060 = 52.5
# avg / 46.6 P1 (the raster chart; the 41.8 a page summary offered belongs to the
# Presets are ComputerBase's own, read off the settings table on page 1, never
# inferred. Upscaling is per chart; ComputerBase states every GPU renders at the
# same internal resolution (DLSS 4.5 / FSR 4.1, FSR 3.1 where 4.1 is unsupported).
#   - 3.440 × 1.440 charts (no 21:9 slot), every ray-traced chart (no RT slot).
#     Indiana Jones, Star Wars Outlaws, Doom: The Dark Ages and Crimson Desert
#     are charted only with RT here, so this review yields nothing for them.
#   - Pragmata: its "Quality-Preset" names no tier, and a tier is never guessed.
#   - Arc Pro B70: no catalogue part.
#   - Cards added in later updates (RTX 5070 22.05, RX 9070 29.05, RX 9070 GRE,
#     RTX 5080 17.07.2026) were run on the same bench; the article does not state
#     a changed driver for them, so none is claimed.
